examples.arabic: جول حلو دخل مرمى الخصم! كلنا صرخنا جامد من الفرحة.
examples.english: A beautiful goal went into the opponent's net! All of us screamed loudly from joy.
examples.transliteration: Gool 7elw dakhal marma el khasem! Kollena sarakhna gamed men el far7a.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: احمد بيجيب جول جميل في الاخر
examples.english: Ahmed scores a beautiful goal in the end.
examples.transliteration: ahmed beygeeb goal gameel fe el akher

examples.arabic: واحد من اللعيبة جري بسرعة على الجول
examples.english: One of the players ran quickly towards the goal.
examples.transliteration: Wahed men el-le'eeba geri besur'a 'ala el-goal.

examples.arabic: فريقه جاب جول كبير علي صرخ بفرحة
examples.english: His team scored a big goal Ali screamed with joy.
examples.transliteration: Faree'o gaab goal kibeer Ali sarakh befarha.
examples.storyTitle: A Football Match and Ali's Joy

examples.arabic: لما فريقنا جاب جول كل الناس صرخوا بفرحة كبيرة
examples.english: When our team scored a goal, everyone screamed with great joy.
examples.transliteration: Lamma faree'na gab goal kol elnas sarakho befara7a kebeera
